paite: Numei pil in innte alam a; himahleh mihai in amah khut in aphelsia.
Atang a gamtami in TOUPA akihta a; himahleh alampite a hoih lou in amah amusit hi.
Mihai kam ah kisaktheihna chiang a-om; himahleh mipil mukte'n huaite ahawi ding hi.
Bawngtalte omlouhna ah, anpiakna kuang asiang a; himahleh bawngtal hatna ziak in nakpi a punna a-om hi.
Theihpih ginom in zuau agen kei ding; himahleh theihpih zuauthei in zuau agen hi.
Musitmi in pilna azong a, amu kei hi; himahleh theihsiamna nei a ding in theihna abaih hi.
Mihai a-omna ah lut in, amah ah theihna mukte na mu kei ding hi.
Mipilvang pilna a lampi theihsiam ahi a; himahleh mihaite haina khemna ahi.
Mihai in khelhna achiamnuihbawl a; himahleh mitangte lak ah deihsakna a-om hi.
Lungtang in amah khatna athei a; huan mikhual in anopsakna atokbuai kei hi.
Migiloute inn suksiat in a-om ding; himahleh mitang biakbuk apha ding hi.
Mihing a dia lampi dik a kilawm a-om a, himahleh huai tawpna sihna lampite ahi.
Lungtang nuihna nangawn lungkhamna ahi a; huan vualnopna tawpna gikna ahi.
Lungtang a nungtolhmi amah lampite a dimsak in a-om ding; huan mihoih amah mah a kipan a hihlungkim in a-om ding hi.
Mimawl in thu chih a-um a; himahleh mipilvang in apaina hoihtak in a-en hi.
Mipil in akihta a, gilou a kipan apaimang; himahleh mihai bel ngottat in, akimuang hi.
Kuapeuh hehbaih haitak in agamta ding; huan ngaihtuah giloumi huat in a-om hi.
Mimawl in haina aluah ding; himahleh mipilvang theihna khuksak in a-om ding.
Hoih mai ah hoih lou akun a; huan diktat kongpite ah gilou akun hi.
Genthei amah inveng mahmah muhdah in a-om; himahleh hausa in lawm tampi anei hi.
A-inveng musit in thil ahihkhial a; himahleh migenthei hehpih, ama'n nuam asa hi.
Hoih lou ngaihtuahte apaikhial kei uh maw? Himahleh zahngaihna leh thutak hoih ngaihtuah kiang ah a-om ding hi.
Sepgimna tengteng ah phattuamna a-om; himahleh mukte houlimna taksapna lam kia ah apai hi.
Mipilte ahauhsakna ua theih in a-om uhi; himahleh mihaite ahaina ua theih in a-om uhi.
Theihpih dik in khate asuaktasak a; himahleh zuaugen in khemna a-omsak hi.
TOUPA kihtakna ah muanna hat a-om a; huan atate'n bukna mun anei ding uh.
TOUPA kihtak hinna tuikhuk ahi, sihna thangte a kipan paimangna ding in.
Mipi tamna ah kumpipa thupina a-om; himahleh mipite omlouhna lal siatna ahi.
Kuapeuh ahehhak theihsiamna thupi a kipan ahi; himahleh kuapeuh lungtom in haina atawisang hi.
Lungtang hoih taksa a dia hinna ahi; himahleh hazatna guhte muatna ahi.
Kuapeuh genthei nuaisiah in abawlpa simmoh ahi; himahleh kuapeuh tasam tung a zahngaihna nei in amah azahtak hi.
Migilou agitlouh hihna a paihlut in a-om a; himahleh midiktat in asihna ah lametna anei hi.
Theihsiamna nei lungtang ah pilna akhawl a; himahleh mihaite sunglam pang a om kitheihsak in a-om hi.
Diktatna in nam atawisang a; himahleh khelhna mi kuapeuh a ding in zahlakna ahi.
Sikha piltak a gamta kiang ah kumpipa deihsakna a-om a; himahleh zumna omsak tung ah athangpaihna a-om hi.
